basis: reconstructed from RAW BID OHLC + frozen level construction; break_risk is NOT reused as BREAK_ATTEMPT (task 14)

reused_frozen_constants.note: constants are READ from the frozen registry; none is changed

diagnostic_constants_declared.note: DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY constants chosen a priori, documented, never written back to any registry

mutual_exclusivity_rule: every (timestamp, level_id) carries at most one PRIMARY state; if two or more states at the SAME phase_level are simultaneously satisfied the record is AMBIGUOUS_STATE and no priority is applied (task 9)

NO_STRUCTURE.entry_condition: no ACTIVE level exists at this bar (nearest-level resolution returns None)

APPROACH.entry_condition: level ACTIVE AND NOT in_band AND dist_atr <= 1.0
APPROACH.persistence_condition: level ACTIVE AND NOT in_band AND dist_atr <= 1.0
APPROACH.ambiguity_condition: if PENETRATION / BREAK_* are simultaneously satisfied

FIRST_TOUCH.entry_condition: band ENTER event (previous bar NOT in_band, current bar in_band) AND band_episode_index == 1 for this level_id
FIRST_TOUCH.exit_condition: band EXIT event (previous in_band, current NOT in_band) OR promotion to PENETRATION/BREAK phase

REPEATED_TOUCH.entry_condition: band ENTER event with band_episode_index >= 2 (a previous EXIT must have occurred)

PENETRATION.entry_condition: in_band AND ( pen_atr >= PENETRATION_ATR OR close crossed to the opposite side of level.price inside the band episode )
PENETRATION.exit_condition: exit from band OR promotion to BREAK_ATTEMPT
PENETRATION.ambiguity_condition: co-occurrence with FIRST_TOUCH/REPEATED_TOUCH at the same phase

BREAK_ATTEMPT.entry_condition: close beyond level.price by >= BREAK_CLOSE_ATR*ATR AND a band touch episode exists within RECOVERY_WINDOW_BARS AND break not yet confirmed
BREAK_ATTEMPT.exit_condition: BREAK_CONFIRMED, or close returns to the original side (RECLAIM)
BREAK_ATTEMPT.persistence_condition: attempt condition holds and not confirmed/reclaimed

BREAK_CONFIRMED.entry_condition: close beyond level.price by >= BREAK_CLOSE_ATR*ATR for >= BREAK_CONFIRM_BARS consecutive bars
BREAK_CONFIRMED.exit_condition: RECLAIM (close returns to the original side)

RECLAIM.entry_condition: after a BREAK_ATTEMPT/BREAK_CONFIRMED, close returns to the pre-touch side within RECOVERY_WINDOW_BARS
RECLAIM.exit_condition: a new band episode starts, or the level is retired

FAILED_BREAK.entry_condition: a BREAK_ATTEMPT existed AND a RECLAIM followed it (break formed then failed)
FAILED_BREAK.ambiguity_condition: co-occurrence with RECLAIM; MUST NOT be assigned when no attempt ever formed (task 16)

EXHAUSTION.entry_condition: touch_events_240 >= EXHAUSTION_MIN_TOUCHES_240 AND penetration trending deeper AND no net progress beyond the level
EXHAUSTION.ambiguity_condition: SUBSTATE only: EXHAUSTION must NOT be equated with REVERSION (task 18)

event_lifecycle_rule: FIRST_TOUCH counts one BAND_ENTER event; consecutive STAY bars must never increment the touch count (task 11/12)
lookahead_rule: state S(t) uses only data <= t; S(t+1) may only be used as a LABEL (task 34)
null_shuffle_purpose: sanity only; never used to search for a best state sequence or to tune anything
